description: The initialized solver returns failure exactly when the input problem has no unifier.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify_failure_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Problem L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify P = none ↔
    ¬∃ σ, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.Unifies σ P
